title: Koala
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#c8d6e2'/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx='28' cy='66' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#8fa3b8' transform='rotate(15 28 66)'/>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='66' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#8fa3b8' transform='rotate(-15 72 66)'/>
    <!-- feet -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#7d91a6'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#7d91a6'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='32' r='13' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='32' r='13' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='32' r='8' fill='#e6b8c2'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='32' r='8' fill='#e6b8c2'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#a3b6c8'/>
    <!-- snout -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#dbe6ef'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#4a5568'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#2d3748'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#2d3748'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='39' r='1.1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='39' r='1.1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d='M46 54 Q50 58 54 54' stroke='#4a5568' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
